title: Plan with fixed milestones and agile delivery
summary: Many organisations need fixed dates and approval points, but teams still work in short cycles. Plan so both work together.

beginner: List the fixed milestones and approval points, and what each needs.
Plan the work in short cycles that lead to each milestone.
Agree what is fixed, such as the date, and what can flex, such as scope.
Show progress against milestones in a way leaders understand.
intermediate: Plan short delivery cycles towards them.
Agree what is fixed and what flexes.
experienced: Negotiate milestone criteria that reward outcomes, not documents.
Bridge agile reporting and governance needs.
Reduce unnecessary approval steps over time.

toolExamples.jira: Use versions or milestones linked to sprints.
toolExamples.azure-devops: Use delivery plans with milestone markers.
toolExamples.sharepoint-word: Keep governance documents in one place.

pitfalls: Fixing date, scope and quality all at once
